responsibility: This module is the root integration layer for GCC's Rust frontend, covering the language-specific infrastructure that plugs Rust into GCC and coordinates a Rust compilation session before and around the deeper frontend passes. Its files define how Rust is registered with GCC's configure, build, option, and driver machinery (`Make-lang.in`, `config-lang.in`, `lang-specs.h`, `lang.opt`, `rustspec.cc`, `rust-lang.cc`); provide the core session control plane and stage orchestration for parsing through analysis, metadata export, and code generation (`rust-session-manager.*`); and supply shared frontend services such as diagnostics and error codes, source location/linemap handling, target hooks and cfg discovery, attribute handling, operator classification, backend abstraction plus the GCC-backed lowering bridge, and object-section import/export of Rust crate metadata. Together these files distinguish this module as the top-level Rust language support and GCC integration subsystem, rather than the language-internal AST, parser, type-checking, or lowering submodules that it invokes.
